name: teaser
description: Batch 1 and 2 course teasers (2026-11-17 to 2026-11-19): every shot voice-over only, no presenter, voice 1.12x. Kept so earlier teasers stay reproducible; new teasers use teaser@2.

prompt.head: Vertical video, 8 seconds, full frame edge to edge, no letterbox or black bars.
prompt.voice_over: An unseen narrator speaks in Urdu as a voice-over only; nobody on screen speaks: "{line}"
prompt.presenter: An unseen narrator speaks in Urdu as a voice-over only; nobody on screen speaks: "{line}"
prompt.tail: Crisp warm daylight, realistic cinematic look. Modest dress. No on-screen text, captions, letters, logos or watermarks; any papers or screens are blurred and unreadable.
